clips.send: Fragments and run-ons. The two most common sentence errors. Fragment: missing a subject or verb, or just a dependent clause. Fix: attach it to a sentence. Run-on (fused): “The bus was late we missed the bell.” Comma splice: “The bus was late, we missed the bell.”. Fix a run-on 4 ways: period, semicolon, comma + FANBOYS, or make one clause dependent. Fragment equals too little. Run-on equals too much, no glue. Long is not equal to run-on. A long sentence that’s properly joined is fine.

clips.send: Compound-complex. Two+ independent clauses + at least one dependent. “When the lights flickered, Dad searched for the flashlight, and my little brother cheered.”. Great for showing how events connect, but don’t chain too many: readers get lost. Dickens’s first sentence in A Tale of Two Cities is a famous giant. Compound + complex equals both rules at once. Count clauses, not words.

clips.send: Phrase vs. clause. A clause has a subject AND a verb; a phrase doesn’t. Phrase: “after the game”, “my little brother”: no subject + verb pair. Clause: “my brother cheered”: subject (brother) + verb (cheered). Independent clause: makes sense alone. Dependent clause: starts with a word like because, when, although, if, until and needs an independent clause. Clause equals who + does what. “Because I was tired.” has a subject and verb but is still a fragment: “because” makes it dependent.

clips.send: Compound sentence. Two or more independent clauses joined. Join with a comma + FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. Or join with a semicolon: “The lights went out; we lit candles.”. 人教版英语 calls this 并列句. FANBOYS equals For And Nor But Or Yet So. A comma alone can’t join two sentences: that’s a comma splice.

clips.send: Simple sentence. One independent clause. “The storm knocked out the power.”. Simple doesn’t mean short: “My little brother and I searched the dark kitchen for candles and matches.” is still simple. It can have two subjects or two verbs and still be one clause. 1 independent, 0 dependent. Two verbs is not equal to two clauses. “I ran and jumped” is simple.

clips.send: Complex sentence. One independent + at least one dependent clause. Dependent first, comma: “When the lights flickered, Dad grabbed a flashlight.”. Dependent last, usually no comma: “Dad grabbed a flashlight when the lights flickered.”. Subordinating words: because, when, although, if, since, until, while, after, before. AAAWWUBBIS: as, although, after, while, when, unless, because, before, if, since. In English “complex” means it has a dependent clause, not that it is hard to read.

clips.send: 并列复合句。两个以上独立分句 + 至少一个从句。“When the lights flickered, Dad searched for the flashlight, and my little brother cheered.”。很适合表现事件之间的联系，但不要串得太长，读者会迷路。狄更斯《双城记》的第一句就是一个著名的“超长句”。并列 + 复合 等于 两套规则一起用。数分句，不是数单词。

clips.send: 残缺句与连写句。最常见的两种句子错误。残缺句：缺主语或谓语，或者只有一个从句。修改：把它接到一个完整的句子上。连写句：“The bus was late we missed the bell.” 逗号粘连句：“The bus was late, we missed the bell.”。修改连写句有 4 种办法：句号、分号、逗号 + 并列连词，或把其中一个分句改成从句。残缺句 等于 太少；连写句 等于 太多又没有“胶水”。长句不等于连写句。连接正确的长句没问题。

clips.send: 简单句。一个独立分句。“The storm knocked out the power.”（暴风雨把电打断了。）。简单句不一定短：“My little brother and I searched the dark kitchen for candles and matches.”仍然是简单句。它可以有两个主语或两个谓语，但只有一个分句。1 个独立分句，0 个从句。两个动词不等于两个分句。“I ran and jumped”是简单句。

clips.send: 短语与分句。分句有主语和谓语，短语没有。短语（phrase）：“after the game”“my little brother”，没有“主语 + 谓语”的组合。分句（clause）：“my brother cheered”，有主语（brother）和谓语（cheered）。独立分句能单独成句；从属分句以 because、when、although、if、until 等词开头，必须依附一个独立分句。中文常叫它“从句”。分句 等于 谁 + 做什么。“Because I was tired.”有主语有谓语，但仍是残缺句：because 让它变成了从句。

clips.send: 并列句。两个或多个独立分句连在一起。用“逗号 + FANBOYS”连接：for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so（并列连词）。或者用分号连接：“The lights went out; we lit candles.”。人教版英语叫它“并列句”。FANBOYS 等于 for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so 的首字母。光用逗号不能连接两个句子，那叫逗号粘连句。

clips.send: 复合句（主从复合句）。一个独立分句 + 至少一个从句。从句在前，加逗号：“When the lights flickered, Dad grabbed a flashlight.”。从句在后，通常不加逗号：“Dad grabbed a flashlight when the lights flickered.”。从属连词：because, when, although, if, since, until, while, after, before（引导状语从句）。记住常见从属连词：as, although, after, while, when, unless, because, before, if, since。英语里 complex 是指“含有从句”，不是指“难懂”。
